units.source_text: 内大臣突然闻此消息，急欲一见此女，心情忐忑不安。

en.t: The Minister of the Interior suddenly heard this news and urgently wanted to see the girl, his heart uneasy and restless.

units.source_text: 他想：“如果立刻接她回来，以父亲身份对待她，亦恐有所不便。

en.t: He thought, "If I immediately bring her back and treat her as my daughter, there may also be difficulties.

units.source_text: 况且推想源氏寻获她时的初心，生怕不见得清白无私而肯慷慨地归还我。

en.t: Besides, when I consider Genji's first intentions in finding her, I fear they may not have been so pure and selfless that he would generously return her to me.

units.source_text: 只因对各位高贵的夫人有所忌惮，未便公然将她归入妻妾之列。

en.t: It is only because he is wary of his noble ladies that he cannot openly place her among his wives and concubines.

units.source_text: 而偷偷地宠爱她，又恐引起世人非议，因此向我言明了吧。”

en.t: And if he secretly favored her, he would fear public criticism, so that must be why he has told me plainly."

units.source_text: 他觉得不快，但又想：“这也算不得缺憾，

en.t: He felt displeased, but then thought, "This cannot really be counted as a defect.

units.source_text: 即使我特地将女儿送与源氏太政大臣为妾，也有什么不体面呢？

en.t: Even if I had deliberately given my daughter to Genji, the Grand Minister, as a concubine, what would be improper about that?

units.source_text: 不过太政大臣要送她入宫，深恐弘徽殿女御见嫉，这倒是很没趣的。

en.t: However, if the Grand Minister means to send her into the palace, I deeply fear the Kokiden Consort's jealousy, and that is indeed unpleasant.

units.source_text: 但归根结底，总不能违背太政大臣的意旨。”

en.t: But in the end, I cannot go against the Grand Minister's wishes."
He turned all sorts of thoughts over in his mind.
This took place at the beginning of the second month.
